description: Validation of the protocol E6 tier 1 transfer helper before the next A100 session: synthetic tests and the real-archive self-check. Both ran on gnode2 from an uncommitted copy of the working tree whose helper and test hashes are recorded here; the commit that adds these files contains the same bytes.

committed_source.verification: The helper and test SHA-256 values recorded here match their file bytes at this commit.
committed_source.scope: Retrospective hash-to-commit linkage, not an execution-time Git identity. The jobs ran from an uncommitted copy; the original self-check report and its helper.commit null are unchanged. No rerun was performed for this annotation.

tests.result: 30 passed (gnode2 job 52101, CPU, opendde-dev; pytest basetemp on /data, removed afterwards)
covers: equal payloads with different strides pass with differing file hashes
one-bit, missing/added/nested key, shape and dtype changes fail
NaN, +inf and -inf fail even when identical on both sides
floats compared bit for bit, strings exactly
valid replay_source relocation passes; unrelocated path, wrong reference with matching payload, wrong run-record replay dir fail
a contrast fails when its reference fails; role structure enforced
missing on one side, same missing on both, two empty roots, same unexpected capture or artifact on both sides fail
D4-style exclusion allows only the excluded contrast; its reference off stays required
declaration refuses held-out rows and is never rewritten; command-line exit status

self_check.job: gnode2 job 52103 (2026-10-16 14:28-14:35 UTC), run from ~/opendde-c6 at qual-sm120-contract-6 (clean)
self_check.relocation: /ephemeral/porting/runs/cal -> the NAS root, for replay captures and run records
self_check.inventory: a100_transfer_selfcheck_inventory_2026-10-16.json (D1-D15, contrasts k and fp32, D4:fp32 excluded, full runs plus ln)
self_check.scope: Validates the retained NAS copy, the all-tensor non-finite rule against the archive (no archived capture holds a non-finite tensor), and path resolution on the real VM paths; it cannot recover the VM originals or close the recorded provenance gaps.

execution_sources.working_directory: ~/opendde-c6 at qual-sm120-contract-6, clean: supplied the manifest (sha256 da61479120291a55dd75e462d8e498ca0ef0b4bf9866d0a659ba5acb3cb088ae) and the row input files
execution_sources.imported_modules: accept.py and compare_outputs.py were imported from the scripts/qualification directory beside the helper, i.e. the uncommitted copy in ~/opendde-dev-checks/helper-src, not from ~/opendde-c6; before the self-check, diff -r showed that copy's scripts/qualification sources identical to ~/opendde-c6 (only bytecode caches differed)
execution_sources.declaration_reproduced: 2026-10-16: the declaration regenerated from ~/opendde-c6 with the same arguments is identical to the retained one apart from created_utc
execution_sources.scope: Additive annotation; the original report is unchanged and no rerun was performed for it.
